content_of_post_to_answer: How does stress affect your sleep and daily life?
answer: Stress does not only steal sleep; it changes the brain's relationship with rest. When your mind stays in threat-detection mode, even quiet moments can feel unsafe, which makes recovery harder. The overlooked issue is that exhaustion and stress can reinforce each other. I've written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone who wants to explore it further. Sleep is not just time away from life; it is the process that helps you return to it.
